meta.name: B - set vault seed minimum to 90 USDG (NOT current policy)
meta.description: setParams on VaultLauncher. Only minSeedEscrow changes, to 90 USDG. The other four are passed at their current on-chain values so they are not reset. DO NOT RUN THIS UNLESS YOU WANT 90 USDG LAUNCHES BACK. The escrow floor is the minimum first-loss capital a manager must post to launch a vault, checked at VaultLauncher.sol:233. It was deliberately set to 1,000 USDG on 7 September 2026 and that is the standing decision; this batch predates it and is kept as a working artifact, not as a pending action. HISTORY, BECAUSE IT WAS MISREAD ONCE. This batch ran at block 56,896,762 on 7 September, because the 1,000 USDG setting was mistaken for a stale Safe proposal having clobbered it. It had not been: Safe's Transaction Service shows the 1,000 USDG transactions at nonces 16 and 19 were each proposed 19 to 30 seconds before they executed, with both owners signing, so they were deliberate and current. The floor was returned to 1,000 USDG sixteen minutes later at block 56,906,350. Net effect of the mistake was 90 USDG for sixteen minutes. IF YOU DO RUN IT, re-verify first: its safety property is that the other four arguments equal the launcher's current values, which was true on 7 September and is not guaranteed later. test/fork/SeedMinimumBatch.t.sol replays this file and asserts exactly that. Check minSeedEscrow afterwards rather than assuming it held. The live zsUSDG vault is unaffected either way: minSeedEscrow is read only inside the launch path, so it gates new launches and never touches an existing vault's escrow.
